sources.title: stunmuffin/TinyTurk-v2.7d · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TinyTurk v2.7d is a 1.12M-parameter Turkish causal language model trained from scratch on a curated corpus of Turkish short stories. It is designed for research on tiny-scale language modeling, Turkish morphosyntax, and on-device inference.
